items.title: E01-S01 · Repository bootstrap
items.body:
**Epic:** E01 — Project foundation  
**Priority:** Must · **Milestone:** M0 Skeleton + login · **Estimate:** 2 h · **Suggested owner:** A (design track: A)

> As a **team**, we want **a shared repository structure, conventions and local infrastructure** so that **everyone can start coding in parallel without stepping on each other**.

**Acceptance criteria**
- **Given** a fresh clone, **when** a developer runs `docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.dev.yaml up -d`, **then** postgres, redis, seaweedfs and mailpit report healthy.
- **Given** the hooks are enabled, **when** someone commits `update stuff` or a file outside `UNIX_CLUB/`, **then** the commit is rejected.
- The branch `UNIX_CLUB/main` exists on the official repo and contains the skeleton.

### Tasks
- [ ] **E01-S01-T1** · Create `UNIX_CLUB/main` from `main`; add `UNIX_CLUB/` with `backend/`, `frontend/`, `deploy/`, `.gitignore` (Java, Node, `.env`), `.editorconfig`, stub `README.md` — OPS, 0.5 h, owner A
- [ ] **E01-S01-T2** · Add `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the 3 Git hooks (`commit-msg`, `pre-commit`, `pre-push`) in `UNIX_CLUB/.githooks/` — DOC, 0.5 h, owner A, depends on T1
- [ ] **E01-S01-T3** · Add `compose.yaml`, `compose.dev.yaml`, `deploy/seaweedfs/s3.json`, `.env.example` — OPS, 0.75 h, owner A, depends on T1
- [ ] **E01-S01-T4** · Every developer: enable hooks, copy `.env`, start compose, confirm health; agree on the secret-sharing channel — OPS, 0.25 h, owner A, depends on T2, T3

### Branch
`UNIX_CLUB/dev/chore(E01-S01)/repository-bootstrap` (bootstrap push with `ALLOW_INTEGRATION_PUSH=1`)

### Design references
- 09-deployment §4, §6, §7 (`docs/09-deployment.md`)
- CONTRIBUTING §5 (`docs/implementation/CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- guide 00 (`docs/implementation/guide/00-prerequisites-and-accounts.md`)
- guide 01 (`docs/implementation/guide/01-repository-bootstrap.md`)

---

items.title: E02-S01 · Login with 42
items.body:
**Epic:** E02 — Identity and authentication  
**Priority:** Must · **Milestone:** M0 Skeleton + login · **Estimate:** 3.5 h · **Suggested owner:** A + B (design track: A)

> As a **42 student**, I want to **log in with my intra account** so that **I don't need another password and my profile is filled in automatically**.

**Acceptance criteria**
- **Given** a 42 account, **when** I click "Login with 42" and accept, **then** I land on `/` logged in and `GET /api/me` returns my login, display name and avatar.
- **Given** I log in a second time, **then** my profile is refreshed and no duplicate user is created.
- **Given** no session, **when** the SPA calls `GET /api/me`, **then** it gets `401` (not a redirect).
- **Given** my login is in `APP_ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_LOGINS`, **then** my first login makes me `ADMIN`.

### Tasks
- [ ] **E02-S01-T1** · Register the 42 OAuth app with the 3 redirect URIs (dev, local prod, `https://42clubroom.ensui.dev`); share `FT_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` privately — OPS, 0.25 h, owner B

- [ ] **E02-S01-T3** · `FortyTwoProfileMapper`, `FortyTwoOAuth2UserService`, `ClubroomOAuth2User` — BE, 0.5 h, owner A, depends on T2
- [ ] **E02-S01-T4** · `UserProvisioningService` + `UserRegistered` / `UserProfileSynced` events, `IdentityProperties` — BE, 0.5 h, owner A, depends on T2
- [ ] **E02-S01-T5** · `SecurityConfig` (URL rules, OAuth2 login, 401 entry point, logout), `SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler`, Spring Session Redis config — BE, 1 h, owner A, depends on T3
- [ ] **E02-S01-T6** · `MeController` + `MeResponse` + `UserDirectoryService.requireMe` — BE, 0.25 h, owner A, depends on T4
- [ ] **E02-S01-T7** · Tests: mapper unit test with a sample `/v2/me` JSON; `@WebMvcTest` asserting 401 on `/api/me` without session — TEST, 0.5 h, owner A, depends on T5

### MVP cut (saves ~0.5 h)
skip T7's web test; keep the mapper test (42's JSON is the riskiest part).

items.title: E05-S01 · Space model, access evaluator and default space
items.body:
**Epic:** E05 — Community spaces and access control  
**Priority:** Must · **Milestone:** M1 Clubs exist · **Estimate:** 2.75 h · **Suggested owner:** B (design track: B)

> As a **club**, we want **a default "General" space (Posts forum + Lounge chat) created on approval, and consistent access rules** so that **the club is usable immediately and private content stays private**.

**Acceptance criteria**
- **Given** a club is approved, **then** within seconds it has a space "General" (read `PUBLIC`, write `CLUB_MEMBERS`) with channels "Posts" (FORUM) and "Lounge" (CHAT). Processing the event twice creates nothing new.
- The access matrix holds (unit tests):
  - `PUBLIC` space: any logged-in user reads;
  - `CLUB_MEMBERS`: only members read/write;
  - `SPACE_ACCESS_ALL` and admins bypass;
  - archived club or archived space: nobody writes;
  - `GROUPS` with no groups: fails closed.
- A write rule broader than the read rule is normalised (R-23).

### Tasks
- [ ] **E05-S01-T1** · `space` migration (`spaces`, `channels`) — DB, 0.25 h, owner B, depends on E01-S02
- [ ] **E05-S01-T2** · Domain `Space`, `Channel`, `AccessRule`, `AccessLevel` + unit tests (normalisation) — BE, 0.75 h, owner B, depends on T1
- [ ] **E05-S01-T3** · `space.api` (`SpaceAccessPolicy`, `SpaceAudience`, `ChannelAccess`, `SpaceAccess`, `ChannelType`) + `SpaceAccessEvaluator` + access-matrix unit tests (mock `ClubCatalog`, `ClubAuthorization`, `GroupMembershipQuery`) — BE, 1.25 h, owner B, depends on T2, E07-S01-T4
- [ ] **E05-S01-T4** · `DefaultSpaceProvisioner` listener on `ClubApproved` — BE, 0.25 h, owner B, depends on T2, E04-S02-T1
- [ ] **E05-S01-T5** · `group.api` interfaces (`GroupMembershipQuery`, `GroupCatalog`, `GroupSummary`, `GroupScope`) + **temporary** implementation (no groups: `false` / empty), replaced in E13-S03 — BE, 0.25 h, owner B, depends on E01-S02

items.title: E07-S02 · Join a club
items.body:
**Epic:** E07 — Membership and joining  
**Priority:** Must · **Milestone:** M2 Community · **Estimate:** 2.5 h · **Suggested owner:** A + C (design track: A + C)

> As a **student**, I want to **join a club in one click (open clubs) or send a request (approval clubs)** so that **I can take part** (subject: "join clubs through the site").

**Acceptance criteria**
- `OPEN` club → `201 {status: JOINED}` and I'm a member immediately; `APPROVAL` club (default) → `202 {status: REQUESTED}`.
- Joining twice → `409 ALREADY_MEMBER`; requesting twice → `409 JOIN_ALREADY_REQUESTED`; archived club → `422 CLUB_NOT_ACTIVE`.
- `GET /api/clubs/{id}/membership/me` returns membership, roles, effective permissions and pending request/invitation. The UI uses it to show or hide controls.
- Leaving works except for the last owner (`422 LAST_OWNER`).

items.body:
**Epic:** E10 — Real-time and chat  
**Priority:** Should · **Milestone:** M3 Calendar · **Estimate:** 2.25 h · **Suggested owner:** B (design track: B + C)

> As a **user with the app open**, I want **new content to appear without refreshing** so that **the clubroom feels alive**, even when the backend runs several instances.

**Acceptance criteria**
- STOMP over `/ws` connects only with a valid session and an allowed `Origin`; client `SEND` frames are rejected.
- Subscribing to an unknown destination, or a channel I can't read, fails; `/user/queue/notifications` always works for myself.
- With 2 backend instances, a push published on instance 1 reaches a browser connected to instance 2 (Redis relay).
- Pushes are sent only after the business transaction commits.

items.body:
**Epic:** E13 — Governance: ownership, roles and groups  
**Priority:** Must · **Milestone:** M4 Lifecycle · **Estimate:** 4 h · **Suggested owner:** A + C (design track: A + C)

> As a **club owner about to graduate**, I want to **invite a member to become co-owner or transfer ownership to them** so that **the club survives my departure** (subject lifecycle: "club ownership transfer").

- An owner invites an active member (`transfer` optional); the invitee sees and accepts or declines it; invitations expire after 7 days (R-11).
- Accepting adds the Owner role; with `transfer = true` the inviter steps down in the same transaction.
- An owner can step down unless they are the last owner (`422 LAST_OWNER`); concurrent step-downs can never leave zero owners (row lock).
- Admins can assign or remove owners (D-22).
- `OwnerAdded`, `OwnerSteppedDown` and `OwnerRemoved` appear in the club history (E14-S03).
